name: AI image ad creatives for marketers
one_liner: Use the new image-generation API to make ad creatives, sold as a service or a simple wrapper tool for marketers and ad agencies.
customer: Performance marketers, ad agencies, e-commerce brands
offer: Done-for-you AI ad image sets, or a self-serve SaaS wrapper that generates ad variants
how_it_makes_money: Per-creative-pack fees or a monthly retainer for the agency version; monthly subscription for the SaaS version (no prices stated)
startup_cost: low (API credits plus a laptop; no amount stated)
evidence: 'Ads are the perfect output for image generation because they make people money. These marketers, they will pay you a lot of money.' (-Whqjr6ZnmY)
Host bought a domain during the talk and planned to build two tools from it (-Whqjr6ZnmY)
No revenue figures or real customer cases given, so evidence is weak (-Whqjr6ZnmY)
risks: A gold rush means lots of fast competitors
Ad platforms and image models may build the same features in
No proven pricing in the transcript

name: Niche or local newsletter with side income streams
one_liner: Start a local or niche newsletter and earn from ads, events, cohorts and recruiting placements, or monetise a business's existing unused email list.
customer: Local advertisers, sponsors, companies hiring talent, event attendees, and businesses with dormant email lists
offer: Newsletter ad slots, paid cohorts or events, talent placement, and newsletter-as-a-service for list owners
how_it_makes_money: Sponsorships and ads; cohort or event tickets; placement fees of $20–30k per hire; rev-share or a fee for running a client's list
time_to_first_revenue: unknown; months to build an audience from scratch, faster if you monetise an existing list
tools: beehiiv or a similar newsletter platform
evidence: 'Every time I logged on Twitter... 10 new local newsletters... all having like crazy success' (1-7Nkz6bTgU)
A design newsletter with 15,000 designers makes six figures from cohorts four times a year and could charge $20–30k placement fees (1-7Nkz6bTgU)
Two surf events a year with about 50 people each produced $250–500k a year (1-7Nkz6bTgU)
Businesses sitting on hundreds of thousands of emails: 'mid 7 figure business just if you converted those emails to a daily newsletter' (1-7Nkz6bTgU)
risks: Audience growth is slow and costs money
Ad income stays small until you have scale
Events need in-person delivery

name: SEO directory websites
one_liner: Build niche 'near me' directory sites where search demand is higher than supply, then earn passive income once they rank.
customer: Listed businesses, advertisers and affiliate partners (searchers use it free)
offer: A niche location-based directory, e.g. thrift stores, dog parks or Mexican food trucks
how_it_makes_money: Display ads, affiliate links, paid or featured listings; one site makes $2,300–3,000 a month
time_to_first_revenue: months (you have to wait for it to rank)
evidence: 'That one backlink that got me to rank one has resulted in 2 years worth of... passively $2,300 to $3,000 a month' (1fTGX4sLVqA)
A competitor in the thrifting niche had 100,000 monthly visitors (1fTGX4sLVqA)
'Anyone with about 100 bucks can start a directory' (1fTGX4sLVqA)
Dry ice near me .com is cited as a five-figure business (1fTGX4sLVqA)
risks: Google algorithm changes and AI answers eating clicks
Copycats; three appeared within 24 hours when the founder revealed a domain
Slow ramp-up

name: Lightweight custom apps replacing bloated SaaS for SMBs
one_liner: Vibe-code small, focused tools for trade or service businesses that pay for big SaaS but only use three of its features.
customer: Local service businesses paying $400–500 a month for tools like Jobber
offer: A custom CRM, scheduling or SMS app, with a free tool used to get in the door
how_it_makes_money: Build fee plus a monthly hosting and maintenance fee priced below the SaaS it replaces; upsell other services
evidence: 'If I want the Jobber account that has like the SMS functionality, it's like 4 or 500 bucks a month' (1hlWvRo3tnM)
'The vast majority of businesses might need three of Jobber's hundred features' (1hlWvRo3tnM)
Someone with no coding experience who helps people build wrappers on Replit makes about $60k a month (2B5dCquvK4c)
risks: Ongoing support burden
Clients may be wary of custom software
Discovery calls are usually needed

name: AI voice agent for local businesses
one_liner: Set up AI phone receptionists that answer calls for small businesses.
customer: Local service business owners who miss calls
offer: A configured AI voice agent that answers calls and books appointments
how_it_makes_money: Setup fee plus a monthly subscription (prices not stated)
time_to_first_revenue: days; the first yes came 57 minutes after building the demo
evidence: 'I created an AI voice agent with literally like six clicks. 57 minutes later, I had a business owner that said, Yes, I want to pay' (2B5dCquvK4c)
risks: Crowded market with low barriers to entry
Churn if call quality is poor
Pricing not stated; a single anecdote

name: Furniture (couch) flipping on Facebook Marketplace
one_liner: Get couches cheap or free (sometimes getting paid to haul them away) and resell them locally with delivery.
customer: Local Marketplace buyers who want delivery
how_it_makes_money: Resale margin plus delivery and removal fees; one flip was a $200 buy for a $5,200 sale; $183k in 2023; up to $10k a month
startup_cost: low to medium (a van or trailer plus starting stock)
time_to_first_revenue: days; the founder beat their nursing pay in the first half month
evidence: '2023, I did 183K and that was with a 3-year-old in tow' (1VjBLSQLAuo)
'In my first half month, I made more in my evenings after full-time work than I did my nursing job' (1VjBLSQLAuo)
risks: Physical, local and time-heavy
UK storage and transport costs
Very far from async

name: Financed RV rental arbitrage
one_liner: Finance an RV with a long-term loan, chosen using local demand data, and rent it out by the night.
how_it_makes_money: $200–500 a night in rent against a $200–300 monthly loan payment (US 20–30 year RV financing)
evidence: 'You can finance an RV for 20 to 30 years because it also counts as a home... payment is like $200 to $300' and 'rent it out for... 200 to 500 a night' (2B5dCquvK4c)
risks: The financing structure is US-specific and probably not available in the UK
Damage, insurance and seasonal demand
Debt risk
